snippet.title: Decadence (Trailer 2023)
snippet.description:
Graduation Video Game
School : ISART DIGITAL, the Video Game and 3D Animation / VFX School

Platform: PC
Engine: Unreal Engine 5
Number of players : 1
Genre: 3D Horror Narrative Walking Simulator

Decadence, a psychological horror game, is an immersive experience full of nerve racking events that will make you question reality itself. As you look forward to your wedding anniversary with your wife, what is this unnerving presence that keeps chasing you around?

-- 

Décadence, un jeu d’horreur psychologique, est une expérience immersive remplie d’événements
angoissants qui vous feront questionner la réalité même.
Alors que vous anticipez votre anniversaire de mariage avec votre femme, quelle est cette
présence angoissante qui vous suit partout?

Ready to play Decadence? Visit https://isart-digital.itch.io/decadence

3D Props and Environment / Lighting / Materials / UI / Marketing: Arthur MACABEO-FORGEAU 
3D Props and Environment / Tech Art / Sound Design: Juliette SIRULNICK
3D Props and Environment, Level Art, Project Manager: Louna ZEMP
